 By Ahmad Zaki - 
 Source: Asia Insurance Review | Nov 2026 
 Delegates at EAIC 2026 toured the Tokyo Resilience Project’s storm surge and underground river infrastructure, where automated triggers, layered redundancy and decades of public investment keep one of the world’s most exposed metropolitan areas above water.
